name: 3d-marquee
title: 3D Image Marquee
description: A gallery of many photos arranged in four columns on a rotated 3D plane, so the grid runs diagonally while neighbouring columns slide slowly in opposite directions.
use: A landing section wants a rich image wall behind or beside copy without inventing a layout.
avoid: The wall wants 32 images and moves forever, so it costs data and never stops for motion-sensitive visitors.
a11y: Every photo has a bare 'Image 1' alt and the endless drift ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Dozens of small landscape photos fill the frame as tilted diamonds, separated by thin dotted lines, showing tulips, a white ship, waves, a face and grass. The whole wall leans in perspective, larger toward one corner.
behaves: Alternating columns creep vertically in opposite directions on long ten- and fifteen-second loops, so the wall drifts continuously. Hovering one photo lifts it a few pixels and adds a shadow.
customise: Pass an array of image URLs and an optional className; column count, tilt, speeds and the 600px height are fixed in the source.
weight: moderate: Thirty-two images sit in four columns whose transforms animate non-stop.
